agreed_findings: IK reset confirmed; one fixed start per runner, three starts globally.
Actor prefix isolated from critic suffix during inference; privileged learning and biological/GRF scaffolding persist.
Frozen-policy tests measure start sensitivity, not causal improvement of learning.
Zero physical prosthetic velocities retain governor and biological IK initialization.
Return differences across starts include changing windows, FSM credit, and morphology costs; cannot be assigned to pose alone.
accepted_claude_refinements: Use one start per runner, not three per runner.
Describe flat historical returns as no detected improvement in this run, not a proven optimization plateau mechanism.
Include positive control and same-reward/common critic initialization before a matched reset-distribution PPO comparison.
Keep per-episode resampling distinct from merely increasing the set of worker-fixed starts.
clarifications_to_claude: Reserves were recorded in17STO/case and maximum generalized reserve forces computed, even though they were omitted from the compact comparison capsule; measurement does not imply physical qualification.
Same-reward returns across starts are descriptive totals; their causal/quality comparison requires controlling window/credit/coverage.
The new results do not independently demonstrate that optimizer LR or critic calibration causes limited learning.
